summary: A mixed day dominated by legal developments and retail-sector regulatory changes. Delhi High Court imposes creative cost penalties on lawyers; government mandates BIS certification for smartphone screen protectors from April 1, 2027; India-New Zealand FTA ratifies effective October 20.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court orders lawyers to distribute samosas and tea to DHCBA employees as condition to waive legal costs.
Government mandates BIS certification for smartphone screen protectors effective April 1, 2027, bringing category under compulsory quality standards.
India-New Zealand FTA ratified; trade agreement effective October 20, 2026.
Gautam Adani surpasses Mukesh Ambani as India's richest with ₹9.22 lakh crore wealth, per Hurun India Rich List 2026.
Ola Electric board approves consideration of rights issue to raise up to ₹1,500 crore through equity shares and securities.
